name: pr-eligibility-stale-blocked-review
title: pr-eligibility returns merge_blocked_review from a single possibly-stale mergeStateStatus read
description: classify_non_clean_merge_state diagnoses a non-CLEAN mergeStateStatus from one snapshot with no re-query. Every cause it names is stable except one it does not: a BLOCKED that GitHub clears on its own after a draft-to-ready transition. That case takes the last branch and returns merge_blocked_review, naming a branch-protection cause that needs a human decision for a state that resolves itself.
creator: sdelmas
